name: pw-smoke
notes: Smoke fixture for the playwright-native/1 composition (issue #55 / F4): a real `vdelta run -- node .../@playwright/test/cli.js test` invocation against a 3-project (setup/auth-tests/chromium) synthetic project records a run, and the recorded instrument identifies itself as the playwright adapter with the capability declaration docs/compositions/playwright-native-1.md §8/§4 fixes (decision 6): source-region-text and retry-evidence are 'pass', resolved-config-coverage is 'unsupported' -- and because resolved-config-coverage is deliberately NOT one of schema.ts's EVIDENCE_CAPABILITY_NAMES, a comparison report's failure_evidence.degraded_capabilities stays empty even though the record itself discloses the degradation (src/compare.ts evidenceDisclosure). The red test's recorded finding also carries a non-empty tree-reconstructed evidence.errors[0].source_region (CE-1, provenance in composition doc §8).
